note: Hand-authored inputs for tools/map-processor/build_map.py. Everything here is manual-approx.
zoneAnchorsNote: Game uu. A zone listed here is measured from this floor point instead of from its callout, because the callout's own floor was not chosen by the snap. See tools/map-mesh/README.md.

b-danger.basis: Game metres (x, y, z). Callout (-58.50, 7.00, z 6.25); on this map callouts sit 1.23 m above their floor (median, MAD 0.27), so its floor is at about 5.0 m. Directly under it is the ledge Shell_5_AtkPathBLedgeB (x -59.18..-57.72, y 3.85..10.10, top z 5.56) on the west face of Shell_5_AtkPathBWaterTower (x -57.94..-50.00, y 3.00..10.94, z -4.09..20.56): 38 walk cells (9.5 m2), 1.5 m wide and 6.5 m long, floor z 4.48..5.54, 4.94 at the callout. 38 cells is under the 40-cell floor the snap accepts, so the zone was placed on the next surface in reach: the water tower's roof (z 16.15, 161 cells, x -56.75..-50.75), 1.75 m away in x,y and 9.9 m above the callout. Anchor = the callout's own x,y at the ledge's measured floor height. The ledge is an island of the walk grid: its north end (-58.25, 10.00, z 4.53) is 2.5 m edge-to-edge from the B-side floor at (-58.25, 13.00, z 3.90) and its south end (-58.75, 4.00, z 5.54) 2.5 m from the floor at (-58.75, 1.00, z 6.01); no triangle of any object lies in either gap except the tower wall. It is entered and left by a jump over the void: the two gaps are the traversals b-danger-north / b-danger-south in this file.
b-danger.provenance: measured-on-mesh (object names, extents, heights, gaps); manual-approx (that the gaps are crossed by a jump: game knowledge)

traversalsNote: Game uu. Ropes, ziplines, teleporters and jumps measured on the scene: a and b are the walk-grid cells at the two ends (they become roadmap nodes joined by a link in <map>.nav.json), zones the zone at each end. See tools/map-mesh/README.md.

traversals.name: Jump A Link ledge <-> A Secret
traversals.basis: Game metres. A Secret is the ledge Shell_1_DefPathA_LedgeA (x 32.75..41.21, y -39.32..-36.63; 43 walk cells, floor z 8.43..9.49), an island of the walk grid. a = the last cell of the 10.00 m floor west of it, b = the ledge's first cell: 2.0 m edge to edge (2.5 m cell to cell), the ledge 0.51 m lower.
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (the ledge, the two cells, the gap, the height difference; no triangle of any object lies in the gap); manual-approx (that the gap is crossed by a jump, in both directions, and the travel time = cell-to-cell distance / 6.75 m/s run speed: game knowledge, not measured)

traversals.name: Jump A Security floor <-> A Secret
traversals.basis: Game metres. a = the last cell of the 8.00 m floor north of the ledge Shell_1_DefPathA_LedgeA, b = the ledge's northern cell: 2.5 m edge to edge (3.0 m cell to cell), the ledge 0.48 m higher.
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (the ledge, the two cells, the gap, the height difference; no triangle of any object lies in the gap); manual-approx (that the gap is crossed by a jump, in both directions, and the travel time = cell-to-cell distance / 6.75 m/s run speed: game knowledge, not measured)

traversals.name: Jump B Main floor <-> B Danger
traversals.basis: Game metres. B Danger is the ledge Shell_5_AtkPathBLedgeB (38 walk cells, floor z 4.48..5.54) on the west face of Shell_5_AtkPathBWaterTower, an island of the walk grid. a = the last cell of the floor north of it, b = the ledge's northern cell: 2.5 m edge to edge (3.0 m cell to cell), the ledge 0.63 m higher.
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (the ledge, the two cells, the gap, the height difference; no triangle of any object lies in the gap); manual-approx (that the gap is crossed by a jump, in both directions, and the travel time = cell-to-cell distance / 6.75 m/s run speed: game knowledge, not measured)

traversals.name: Jump B Site floor <-> B Danger
traversals.basis: Game metres. a = the last cell of the floor south of the ledge Shell_5_AtkPathBLedgeB, b = the ledge's southern cell: 2.5 m edge to edge (3.0 m cell to cell), the ledge 0.47 m lower.
traversals.provenance: measured-on-mesh (the ledge, the two cells, the gap, the height difference; no triangle of any object lies in the gap); manual-approx (that the gap is crossed by a jump, in both directions, and the travel time = cell-to-cell distance / 6.75 m/s run speed: game knowledge, not measured)

objectsNotLocated.name: Ultimate orbs
objectsNotLocated.reason: no object of the static scene is an orb: object names were searched for Orb / Ult / Ultimate / Pickup and nothing matched (orbs are spawned actors, not level art). Positions are not guessed.

mechanics.name: No outer walls: players can fall off the map and die
mechanics.engineNeeds: lethal boundary zones / fall hazard on edges next to the void; displacement abilities need a 'knocked off' outcome
mechanics.provenance: manual-approx (general game knowledge; not verified against geometry or a patch in this session)

mechanics.name: Jump gaps between platforms (e.g. mid, B danger)
mechanics.provenance: measured-on-mesh (the two ledges and their gaps); manual-approx (that they are crossed by a jump, and the mid gap: general game knowledge)
mechanics.measured: A Secret = ledge Shell_1_DefPathA_LedgeA (x 32.75..41.21, y -39.32..-36.63; 43 walk cells, floor z 8.43..9.49): 2.0 m edge-to-edge from the 10.00 m floor to its west (island cell (32.75, -38.50, 9.49) <-> (30.25, -38.50, 10.00)) and 2.5 m from the A-site-side floor to its north ((40.75, -37.00, 8.48) <-> (40.75, -34.00, 8.00)); no triangle in either gap. B Danger = ledge Shell_5_AtkPathBLedgeB (38 walk cells, floor z 4.48..5.54): 2.5 m gaps north and south (see zoneAnchors.b-danger). Both zones are walk-grid islands; game metres.
mechanics.how: four roadmap links kind=jump between measured cells (traversals in this file) join the A Secret and B Danger ledges to the floors beside them; the fall risk of a missed jump and the mid gap are NOT modelled
